items.text:
💖 Bright, bubbly, and bursting with fruity goodness! V7 Pink Lemonade delivers the perfect blend of sweetness and citrus sparkle in every refreshing sip.

✨ Your pink refreshment awaits.

V7 Drink Social Media Post
This energetic and fruity visual showcases the "V7 Sparkling Drink" in its Strawberry Pink Lemonade flavor. Designed to evoke freshness and vitality, the composition features a dynamic splash effect with vibrant fruit elements like strawberries, lemons, and citrus slices. The rich red-pink background amplifies the summer vibe, while product highlights such as "Immune Support," "100% Natural Flavors," and enrichment with Vitamin B6 & B12 are clearly presented to appeal to health-conscious consumers. This summer edition design blends flavor, wellness, and visual excitement to create a compelling brand experience.

Created by Mohamed Amr

لذاذة الفراولة مع تويست الليمون ولسعة الصودا من V7 & Dara هتظبط مودك في الصيف. اطلبها دلوقتي

Sweet, tangy, pink, and 100% vibrant! Order the new Pink Lemonade by V7 & Dara now from the app

This is V7’s signature summer edition doing what it does best: citrus with a kick, colour with purpose, and just the right amount of bite. Dara’s does the rest—translating it into a creamy, ice-cold swirl that tastes like it should come with a poolside playlist and SPF 50.
items.previewTitle: ‘V7’ Collaborates With Dara’s Ice Cream on New Pink Lemonade Soda
items.previewDescription: This limited-edition pink lemonade collab is the summer ice-cold cool-down you didn’t know you needed.
